```{r}
#Pull data:

#NCSS data:

    #pedon, taxonomic name and series name: 
    ncss_pedon <- read.csv("../data/Pedon_SCP_MLRA.csv") #siteobsiiref is pedon id
    
    #horizon name, seq, top depth, bottom depth, some texture:
    ncss_phorizon <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phorizon.csv") #peiidref is pedon id (multiples per pedon)
  
    #color per horizon, hue value, chroma:
    ncss_color <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phcolor.csv") #phiidref is pedon id
    
    #mottles present per hz, HVC and percentage:
    ncss_mottles <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phmottles.csv") #phiidref is pedon id
    
    #lab data: CEC
    ncss_labdata <- read.csv("../data/ncss_labdata.csv") #ncsslabdataiidref is pedon id , seq is hz 
    
    #ped_taxa:
    ncss_ped_taxa <- read.csv("../data/petaxhistory.csv")
    
    #ncss pedon lab data:
    ncss_pedonlabdata <- read.csv("../data/ncss_pedonlabdata.csv") 
    
    str(ncss_pedon)
    str(ncss_phorizon)
    str(ncss_color)
    str(ncss_mottles)
    str(ncss_labdata)
    str(ncss_pedonlabdata)
```

```{r}

#try to merge labdata and phorizon based on unique patterns per pedon:
# keep only your pedons
my_pedons <- unique(ncss_pedon$peiid)

# bridge lab layers -> peiidref (pedon)
pedlab_unique <- ncss_pedonlabdata %>%
  mutate(
    filled_n = rowSums(!is.na(across(everything())))
  ) %>%
  group_by(ncsspedonlabdataiid, peiidref, pedlabsampnum) %>%
  arrange(desc(filled_n), desc(recwlupdated)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

lab_with_ped <- ncss_labdata %>%
  left_join(
    pedlab_unique %>% select(ncsspedonlabdataiid, peiidref),
    by = c("ncsspedonlabdataiidref" = "ncsspedonlabdataiid")
  ) %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% my_pedons)
clean_hz <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", NA_character_, x)
  # remove spaces, keep letters+digits
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  x
}

hz_master <- function(x) {
  # take leading letters (A, E, BT, BC, C, O, etc.)
  x <- clean_hz(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, sub("^([A-Z]+).*", "\\1", x))
}

ph <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% my_pedons) %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref, phiid,
    seqnum = as.integer(seqnum),
    hzdept = as.integer(hzdept),
    hzdepb = as.integer(hzdepb),
    hzname = clean_hz(hzname),
    hz_master = hz_master(hzname)
  )

lab <- lab_with_ped %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref,
    lab_layer_id = ncsslayerlabdataiid,          # unique layer id
    layerseqnum = as.integer(layerseqnum),
    hzdept = as.integer(hzdept),
    hzdepb = as.integer(hzdepb),
    hzname_lab = clean_hz(hzname),
    hzname_orig = clean_hz(hznameoriginal),
    hz_master_lab = hz_master(coalesce(hznameoriginal, hzname))
  )


setDT(ph)
setDT(lab)

tol_top <- 2L
tol_bot <- 2L

# precompute acceptable windows for each ph horizon
ph[, `:=`(
  hzdept_lo = hzdept - tol_top,
  hzdept_hi = hzdept + tol_top,
  hzdepb_lo = hzdepb - tol_bot,
  hzdepb_hi = hzdepb + tol_bot
)]

# non-equi join: lab depths must fall within ph windows (within pedon)
cands <- lab[ph,
  on = .(
    peiidref,
    hzdept >= hzdept_lo, hzdept <= hzdept_hi,
    hzdepb >= hzdepb_lo, hzdepb <= hzdepb_hi
  ),
  allow.cartesian = TRUE,
  nomatch = 0L
]

# normalize column names if needed:
# assume ph columns are: phiid, seqnum, hzdept, hzdepb, hz_master
# assume lab columns are: lab_layer_id, layerseqnum, hzdept, hzdepb, hz_master_lab

# compute diffs and score
# score candidates (using your actual cands colnames)
cands[, score := {
  dtop <- abs(hzdept - `i.hzdept`)
  dbot <- abs(hzdepb - `i.hzdepb`)

  depth_exact  <- as.integer(dtop == 0L & dbot == 0L)
  master_match <- as.integer(hz_master_lab == hz_master)
  seq_match    <- as.integer(!is.na(layerseqnum) & !is.na(seqnum) & layerseqnum == seqnum)
  seq_diff     <- fifelse(!is.na(layerseqnum) & !is.na(seqnum), abs(layerseqnum - seqnum), 99L)

  1000 * depth_exact +
    60 * master_match +
    25 * seq_match +
    -5 * (dtop + dbot) +
    -1 * seq_diff
}]

# store diffs for QC
cands[, `:=`(
  d_top = abs(hzdept - `i.hzdept`),
  d_bot = abs(hzdepb - `i.hzdepb`)
)]

# best candidate per horizon (phiid)
best_per_hz <- cands[order(-score), .SD[1], by = .(phiid)]

# enforce 1:1 lab layer usage (greedy)
setorder(best_per_hz, -score)

used <- integer()
final_matches <- best_per_hz[0]

for (k in seq_len(nrow(best_per_hz))) {
  lyr <- best_per_hz$lab_layer_id[k]
  if (!(lyr %in% used)) {
    final_matches <- rbind(final_matches, best_per_hz[k])
    used <- c(used, lyr)
  }
}

final_map <- as.data.frame(final_matches) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    phiid,
    ncsslayerlabdataiid = lab_layer_id,
    match_score = score,
    top_diff = d_top,
    bot_diff = d_bot
  )

cat("Candidate pairs:", nrow(cands), "\n")
cat("Matched horizons:", nrow(final_map), "\n")

final_map %>%
  summarise(
    pct_exact = mean(top_diff == 0 & bot_diff == 0) * 100,
    pct_within_1cm = mean((top_diff + bot_diff) <= 1) * 100,
    pct_within_4cm = mean((top_diff + bot_diff) <= 4) * 100,
    med_top = median(top_diff),
    med_bot = median(bot_diff)
  )

ph_matched <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% my_pedons) %>%
  left_join(final_map, by = "phiid") %>%
  left_join(ncss_labdata, by = c("ncsslayerlabdataiid" = "ncsslayerlabdataiid"))
ph_matched %>%
  summarise(
    n_hz = n(),
    n_matched = sum(!is.na(ncsslayerlabdataiid)),
    match_rate = mean(!is.na(ncsslayerlabdataiid)) * 100
  )

ph_matched %>%
  filter(is.na(ncsslayerlabdataiid)) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unmatched = n(),
    min_top = min(hzdept.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_bot = max(hzdepb.x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
# ph_matched %>%
#   group_by(peiidref) %>%
#   summarise(
#     n_hz = n(),
#     n_matched = sum(!is.na(ncsslayerlabdataiid)),
#     match_rate = n_matched / n_hz
#   ) %>%
#   arrange(match_rate) %>%
#   slice_head(n = 15)
lab_keep <- c("ncsslayerlabdataiid","texcl","sandtotmeasured","silttotmeasured","claytotmeasured",
              "ph1to1h2o","cec7","ecec","carbonorganicpctmeasured")

ph_matched_small <- ph_matched %>%
  left_join(ncss_labdata %>% select(any_of(lab_keep)),
            by = c("ncsslayerlabdataiid" = "ncsslayerlabdataiid"))
lab_ped_features <- ph_matched_small %>%
  filter(!is.na(ncsslayerlabdataiid)) %>%
  mutate(hz_thk = hzdepb.x - hzdept.x) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    wmean_clay_lab = weighted.mean(claytotmeasured.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_sand_lab = weighted.mean(sandtotmeasured.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_ph_lab   = weighted.mean(ph1to1h2o.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# -----------------------------
# 0) Helpers
# -----------------------------
clean_cat <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "Not Classified", "UNKNOWN", x)
  x
}

# -----------------------------
# 1) Pedon-level morphology/texture from hz_slim_clean
#    (thickness-weighted summaries)
# -----------------------------
num_vars <- intersect(
  c("sandtotest","silttotest","claytotest",
    "color_value","color_chroma","mottle_pct"),
  names(hz_slim_clean)
)

hz_ped <- hz_slim_clean %>%
  mutate(
    hz_thk = hzdepb - hzdept,
    hz_thk = ifelse(is.finite(hz_thk) & hz_thk > 0, hz_thk, NA_real_),
    hzname_chr = toupper(as.character(hzname)),
    is_A  = str_detect(hzname_chr, "^A"),
    is_E  = str_detect(hzname_chr, "^E"),
    is_Bt = str_detect(hzname_chr, "BT"),
    is_C  = str_detect(hzname_chr, "^C")
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    max_depth = max(hzdepb, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_hz = n(),
    mean_hz_thk = mean(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    pct_A_thk  = sum(hz_thk[is_A],  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_E_thk  = sum(hz_thk[is_E],  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_Bt_thk = sum(hz_thk[is_Bt], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_C_thk  = sum(hz_thk[is_C],  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    across(all_of(num_vars), ~ weighted.mean(.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "wmean_{.col}"),
    any_mottles = as.integer(any(!is.na(mottle_pct) & mottle_pct > 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

# -----------------------------
# 2) Pedon-level lab features from your horizon-matched lab join
#    (uses ph_matched if present; fallback to ph_matched_small if that’s what you made)
# -----------------------------
ph_lab_src <- if (exists("ph_matched_small")) ph_matched_small else ph_matched

lab_ped <- ph_lab_src %>%
  filter(!is.na(ncsslayerlabdataiid)) %>%
  mutate(
    hz_thk = hzdepb.x - hzdept.x,
    hz_thk = ifelse(is.finite(hz_thk) & hz_thk > 0, hz_thk, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    wmean_clay_lab = weighted.mean(claytotmeasured.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_sand_lab = weighted.mean(sandtotmeasured.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_silt_lab = weighted.mean(silttotmeasured.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_ph_lab   = weighted.mean(ph1to1h2o.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_cec7_lab = weighted.mean(cec7.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_ecec_lab = weighted.mean(ecec.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

# -----------------------------
# 3) Taxonomy (pedon-level)
#    Uses taxa_best if it exists; otherwise skips taxonomy
# -----------------------------
if (exists("taxa_best")) {
  tax_cols <- intersect(
    c("series","taxorder","taxsuborder","taxgrtgroup","taxsubgrp","taxpartsize"),
    names(taxa_best)
  )
  tax_ped <- taxa_best %>%
    select(peiidref, all_of(tax_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(tax_cols), clean_cat))
} else {
  tax_ped <- tibble(peiidref = hz_ped$peiidref)
  tax_cols <- character(0)
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) Combine to one pedon table
# -----------------------------
umap_df <- hz_ped %>%
  left_join(lab_ped, by = "peiidref") %>%
  left_join(tax_ped, by = "peiidref")

# -----------------------------
# 5) One-hot encode taxonomy + numeric matrix (median impute), run UMAP
# -----------------------------
# one-hot
cats_onehot <- if (length(tax_cols) > 0) {
  umap_df %>%
    select(peiidref, all_of(tax_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-peiidref, names_to = "field", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(col = paste0("cat_", field, "_", make.names(value))) %>%
    count(peiidref, col) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
} else {
  umap_df %>% transmute(peiidref)
}

num_block <- umap_df %>%
  select(peiidref, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

umap_ready <- num_block %>% left_join(cats_onehot, by = "peiidref")

umap_mat <- umap_ready %>% select(-peiidref) %>% as.matrix()

set.seed(1)
u <- umap(umap_mat)

umap_res <- umap_df %>%
  mutate(
    UMAP1 = u$layout[, 1],
    UMAP2 = u$layout[, 2]
  )

# -----------------------------
# 6) Plot (pick your color)
# -----------------------------
# color by matched lab sand if available, otherwise by wmean_sandtotest
color_var <- if ("wmean_sand_lab" %in% names(umap_res)) "wmean_sand_lab" else "wmean_sandtotest"

ggplot(umap_res, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = color_var)

#by tax order:
ggplot(umap_res, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = taxsuborder)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "Taxonomic Order")
```

```{r}

# ---- choose bins (edit max depth as you like) ----
bin_edges <- seq(0, 200, by = 10)  # 0-10 ... 190-200
bins <- tibble(
  bin_id = seq_len(length(bin_edges) - 1),
  z_top  = bin_edges[-length(bin_edges)],
  z_bot  = bin_edges[-1]
)

# Use your pedon-scoped horizons (ph_my is best; otherwise filter ncss_phorizon)
hz <- ph_my %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref, phiid,
    hzdept = as.integer(hzdept),
    hzdepb = as.integer(hzdepb),
    hzname = toupper(as.character(hzname))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept)

# horizon-type flags (customize if you want more classes)
hz <- hz %>%
  mutate(
    isA  = as.integer(str_detect(hzname, "^A")),
    isE  = as.integer(str_detect(hzname, "^E")),
    isBt = as.integer(str_detect(hzname, "BT")),
    isC  = as.integer(str_detect(hzname, "^C"))
  )

# Expand each pedon into (horizon x bin) overlaps, then summarise back to pedon
ped_bin_fingerprint <- hz %>%
  inner_join(bins, by = character()) %>%   # cartesian within your pedons
  mutate(
    ol_top = pmax(hzdept, z_top),
    ol_bot = pmin(hzdepb, z_bot),
    ol = pmax(0, ol_bot - ol_top)
  ) %>%
  filter(ol > 0) %>%
  group_by(peiidref, bin_id, z_top, z_bot) %>%
  summarise(
    A_prop  = sum(ol * isA,  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(ol, na.rm = TRUE),
    E_prop  = sum(ol * isE,  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(ol, na.rm = TRUE),
    Bt_prop = sum(ol * isBt, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(ol, na.rm = TRUE),
    C_prop  = sum(ol * isC,  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(ol, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unite(bin, z_top, z_bot, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = peiidref,
    names_from = bin,
    values_from = c(A_prop, E_prop, Bt_prop, C_prop),
    names_sep = "__",
    values_fill = list(A_prop = 0, E_prop = 0, Bt_prop = 0, C_prop = 0)
  )

# Add your pedon-level lab summaries (from your matched lab join)
# (If you already created lab_ped earlier, reuse it.)
lab_ped <- (if (exists("lab_ped")) lab_ped else {
  ph_lab_src <- if (exists("ph_matched_small")) ph_matched_small else ph_matched
  ph_lab_src %>%
    filter(!is.na(ncsslayerlabdataiid)) %>%
    mutate(hz_thk = hzdepb - hzdept) %>%
    group_by(peiidref) %>%
    summarise(
      wmean_clay_lab = weighted.mean(claytotmeasured, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
      wmean_sand_lab = weighted.mean(sandtotmeasured, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
      wmean_ph_lab   = weighted.mean(ph1to1h2o, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
})

umap_df <- ped_bin_fingerprint %>%
  left_join(lab_ped, by = "peiidref") %>%
  #deselect containing "wmean"
  select(-starts_with("wmean"))

# Build matrix: numeric only + median-impute
X <- umap_df %>%
  select(-peiidref) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x))) %>%
  as.matrix()

set.seed(1)
u <- umap(X)

umap_res <- umap_df %>%
  mutate(
    UMAP1 = u$layout[,1],
    UMAP2 = u$layout[,2]
  )

ggplot(umap_res, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

#Link pedlab_unique to ncss_pedon (pedon table)
#ncss_pedon uses peiid (pedon id). pedlab_unique uses peiidref. That’s the bridge.

phorizon_with_pedlab <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  left_join(
    pedlab_unique %>%
      select(peiidref, pedlabsampnum, psctopdepth, pscbotdepth,
             noncarbclaywtavg, claytotwtavg, cec7clayratiowtavg),
    by = "peiidref",
    relationship = "many-to-many"  # suppress warning; this is expected
  )

# get the pedon IDs you actually care about
my_pedons <- ncss_pedon %>% distinct(peiid) %>% rename(peiidref = peiid)

# collapse pedlab to one row per pedon (recommended)
pedlab_by_pedon <- pedlab_unique %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    pedlabsampnum_n = n_distinct(pedlabsampnum),
    psctopdepth = min(psctopdepth, na.rm = TRUE),
    pscbotdepth = max(pscbotdepth, na.rm = TRUE),
    claytotwtavg = mean(claytotwtavg, na.rm = TRUE),
    noncarbclaywtavg = mean(noncarbclaywtavg, na.rm = TRUE),
    cec7clayratiowtavg = mean(cec7clayratiowtavg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# restrict horizons to your pedons only
ph_my <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  semi_join(my_pedons, by = "peiidref")

# now join (no explosion)
ph_my_with_pedlab <- ph_my %>%
  left_join(pedlab_by_pedon, by = "peiidref")

cat("My phorizon rows:", nrow(ph_my_with_pedlab), "\n")
cat("My phorizon rows with pedlab:",
    sum(!is.na(ph_my_with_pedlab$claytotwtavg)), "\n")
cat("My pedons represented:", n_distinct(ph_my_with_pedlab$peiidref), "\n")
cat("My pedons with any pedlab:",
    n_distinct(ph_my_with_pedlab$peiidref[!is.na(ph_my_with_pedlab$claytotwtavg)]), "\n")

pedon_model_df <- ncss_pedon %>%
  left_join(pedlab_by_pedon, by = c("peiid" = "peiidref"))
```

```{r}
# ---- pick numeric horizon variables that exist in hz_slim_clean ----
num_vars <- intersect(
  c("sandtotest","silttotest","claytotest",
    "color_value","color_chroma",
    "mottle_pct"),
  names(hz_slim_clean)
)

hz_ped_features <- hz_slim_clean %>%
  mutate(
    hz_thk = hzdepb - hzdept,
    hzname_chr = as.character(hzname),

    is_A  = str_detect(hzname_chr, "^A"),
    is_E  = str_detect(hzname_chr, "^E"),
    is_Bt = str_detect(hzname_chr, "Bt"),
    is_C  = str_detect(hzname_chr, "^C")
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    max_depth = max(hzdepb, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_hz = n(),
    mean_hz_thk = mean(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    pct_A_thk  = sum(hz_thk[is_A],  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_E_thk  = sum(hz_thk[is_E],  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_Bt_thk = sum(hz_thk[is_Bt], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_C_thk  = sum(hz_thk[is_C],  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    # thickness-weighted means for numeric horizon vars
    across(all_of(num_vars), ~ weighted.mean(.x, hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "wmean_{.col}"),

    # how often do mottles occur?
    any_mottles = as.integer(any(!is.na(mottle_pct) & mottle_pct > 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))
tax_cols <- intersect(
  c("taxonname","taxclname","taxorder","taxsuborder","taxgrtgroup","taxsubgrp","taxpartsize","series"),
  names(taxa_best)
)

tax_ped <- taxa_best %>%
  select(peiidref, all_of(tax_cols))

umap_df <- hz_ped_features %>%
  left_join(tax_ped, by = "peiidref") %>%
  left_join(pedlab_by_pedon_clean, by = "peiidref")
cat_cols <- intersect(
  c("series","taxorder","taxsuborder","taxgrtgroup","taxsubgrp","taxpartsize"),
  names(umap_df)
)

# make categoricals clean
umap_df2 <- umap_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cat_cols), ~{
    x <- str_trim(as.character(.x))
    ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "Not Classified", "UNKNOWN", x)
  }))

# one-hot for categorical columns
cats_onehot <- umap_df2 %>%
  select(peiidref, all_of(cat_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-peiidref, names_to = "field", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(col = paste0("cat_", field, "_", make.names(value))) %>%
  count(peiidref, col) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# numeric block + median impute
num_block <- umap_df2 %>%
  select(peiidref, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

umap_ready <- num_block %>%
  left_join(cats_onehot, by = "peiidref")

umap_mat <- umap_ready %>%
  select(-peiidref) %>%
  as.matrix()

set.seed(1)
u <- umap(umap_mat)

umap_res <- umap_df2 %>%
  select(peiidref, any_of(cat_cols), everything()) %>%
  mutate(
    UMAP1 = u$layout[,1],
    UMAP2 = u$layout[,2]
  )
ggplot(umap_res, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = taxorder)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#========================================================
# 0) Keep set: pedons in your clipped MLRA pedon table
#========================================================
keep_peiid <- ncss_pedon %>% distinct(peiid)

# horizons that belong to those pedons (needed to filter color/mottles by phiid)
keep_hz <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  semi_join(keep_peiid, by = c("peiidref" = "peiid")) %>%
  distinct(peiidref, phiid)

keep_phiid <- keep_hz %>% distinct(phiid)

#========================================================
# 1) Filter each table to the MLRA set
#========================================================
ncss_phorizon_mlra <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  semi_join(keep_peiid, by = c("peiidref" = "peiid"))

ncss_color_mlra <- ncss_color %>%
  semi_join(keep_phiid, by = c("phiidref" = "phiid"))

ncss_mottles_mlra <- ncss_mottles %>%
  semi_join(keep_phiid, by = c("phiidref" = "phiid"))

ncss_ped_taxa_mlra <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  semi_join(keep_peiid, by = c("peiidref" = "peiid"))

#========================================================
# 2) Summarize horizon-level morphology (colors + mottles)
#========================================================
color_summ <- ncss_color_mlra %>%
  mutate(color = str_trim(paste(colorhue, colorvalue, "/", colorchroma))) %>%
  group_by(phiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    colors = paste(unique(na.omit(color)), collapse = "; "),
    dom_color = {
      x <- .[.$colormoistst == "Moist" & .$colorphysst == "Interior", , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(x) == 0) NA_character_
      else str_trim(paste(x$colorhue[1], x$colorvalue[1], "/", x$colorchroma[1]))
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mottle_summ <- ncss_mottles_mlra %>%
  mutate(mottle_color = str_trim(paste(colorhue, colorvalue, "/", colorchroma))) %>%
  group_by(phiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    mottles = paste(
      unique(na.omit(
        paste0(
          ifelse(is.na(mottlepct), "", paste0(mottlepct, "% ")),
          mottlecntrst, " ", mottlesize, " ",
          mottle_color,
          ifelse(is.na(mottleloc) | mottleloc == "", "", paste0(" (", mottleloc, ")"))
        )
      )),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    mottle_pct = {
      x <- suppressWarnings(max(mottlepct, na.rm = TRUE))
      if (is.infinite(x)) NA_real_ else x
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#========================================================
# 3) Choose ONE taxonomy record per pedon (most recent)
#========================================================
taxa_best <- ncss_ped_taxa_mlra %>%
  mutate(
    taxorder = na_if(str_trim(taxorder), ""),
    classtype = str_trim(classtype)
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(classtype == "Sampled as"),
    desc(!is.na(taxorder))
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref,
    series = taxonname,          # <- rename so it won't collide
    taxclname,
    taxorder,
    taxsuborder,
    taxgrtgroup,
    taxsubgrp,
    taxpartsize
  )

#========================================================
# 4) Build horizon master and slim horizon table
#========================================================

hz_master2 <- ncss_phorizon_mlra %>%
  left_join(
    ncss_pedon %>% select(peiid, siteobsiidref, upedonid),
    by = c("peiidref" = "peiid")
  ) %>%
  left_join(taxa_best, by = "peiidref") %>%
  left_join(color_summ,  by = c("phiid" = "phiidref")) %>%
  left_join(mottle_summ, by = c("phiid" = "phiidref"))

hz_slim <- hz_master2 %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref, siteobsiidref, upedonid,
    series, taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize,
    seqnum, hzname, hzdept, hzdepb,
    texture, sandtotest, silttotest, claytotest,
    dom_color, mottle_pct, mottles
  ) %>%
  separate(dom_color, into = c("color_hue", "color_vc"), sep = "\\s+", fill = "right", extra = "merge") %>%
  separate(color_vc, into = c("color_value", "color_chroma"), sep = "/", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    color_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(color_value)),
    color_chroma = suppressWarnings(as.integer(color_chroma))
  )
```

```{r data wrangling}
# helper: choose the most common non-missing value in a vector
mode_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  names(tab)[1]
}

hz_slim_clean <- hz_slim %>%
  mutate(
    # --- 1) clean series name ---
    series = str_squish(series),
    series = str_to_lower(series),
    series = str_to_title(series)  # "RED BAY" -> "Red Bay", "persanti" -> "Persanti"
  ) %>%
  group_by(series) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- 2) make taxonomy identical within series (fill from best/most common) ---
    taxclname   = mode_nonmissing(taxclname),
    taxorder    = mode_nonmissing(taxorder),
    taxsuborder = mode_nonmissing(taxsuborder),
    taxgrtgroup = mode_nonmissing(taxgrtgroup),
    taxsubgrp   = mode_nonmissing(taxsubgrp),
    taxpartsize = mode_nonmissing(taxpartsize)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

first_non_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[1]
}

mode_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  names(tab)[1]
}

pedon_umap <- hz_slim_clean %>%
  mutate(
    hz_thk = hzdepb - hzdept,
    # simplify texture to first class token (handles "SL SL", "SCL", etc.)
    texture_1 = str_squish(str_split_i(texture, "\\s+", 1)),
    # simple horizon “types” for morphology signal
    hz_type = case_when(
      str_detect(hzname, "^[Aa]") ~ "A",
      str_detect(hzname, "^[Ee]") ~ "E",
      str_detect(hzname, "^[Bb]") ~ "B",
      str_detect(hzname, "^[Cc]") ~ "C",
      str_detect(hzname, "^[Rr]") ~ "R",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    is_Bt = str_detect(hzname, "Bt|bt"),
    mid_depth = (hzdept + hzdepb) / 2
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref, upedonid, series) %>%
  summarise(
    # -------- taxonomy (categorical) --------
    taxclname   = first_non_na(taxclname),
    taxorder    = first_non_na(taxorder),
    taxsuborder = first_non_na(taxsuborder),
    taxgrtgroup = first_non_na(taxgrtgroup),
    taxsubgrp   = first_non_na(taxsubgrp),
    taxpartsize = first_non_na(taxpartsize),

    # -------- morphology: depth/sequence --------
    max_depth = max(hzdepb, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hz_thickness = mean(hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    has_A = as.integer(any(hz_type == "A")),
    has_E = as.integer(any(hz_type == "E")),
    has_B = as.integer(any(hz_type == "B")),
    has_C = as.integer(any(hz_type == "C")),

    Bt_present = as.integer(any(is_Bt, na.rm = TRUE)),
    depth_to_first_Bt = suppressWarnings(min(hzdept[is_Bt], na.rm = TRUE)),
    Bt_thickness_total = sum(hz_thk[is_Bt], na.rm = TRUE),

    # -------- morphology: color / redox --------
    # weighted by horizon thickness (more stable than simple mean)
    mean_value  = weighted.mean(color_value,  w = hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_chroma = weighted.mean(color_chroma, w = hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    dom_hue     = mode_chr(color_hue),

    mean_mottle_pct = weighted.mean(mottle_pct, w = hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_mottles = as.integer(any(!is.na(mottle_pct))),

    # -------- texture: lab (numeric) --------
    mean_sand = weighted.mean(sandtotest, w = hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_silt = weighted.mean(silttotest, w = hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_clay = weighted.mean(claytotest, w = hz_thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    # -------- texture: field class (categorical) --------
    dom_texture = mode_chr(texture_1),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # fix the Bt depth when Bt is absent (min(..., na.rm=TRUE) becomes Inf)
    depth_to_first_Bt = ifelse(is.infinite(depth_to_first_Bt), NA_real_, depth_to_first_Bt)
  )
# ----- numeric block -----
num_vars <- pedon_umap %>%
  select(
    max_depth, mean_hz_thickness,
    has_A, has_E, has_B, has_C,
    Bt_present, depth_to_first_Bt, Bt_thickness_total,
    mean_value, mean_chroma,
    mean_mottle_pct, any_mottles,
    mean_sand, mean_silt, mean_clay
  )

# Replace NA in numeric with medians (UMAP cannot take NA)
num_vars_clean <- num_vars %>%
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

# ----- categorical block (taxonomy + morph + texture class) -----
cat_vars <- pedon_umap %>%
  select(
    taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize,
    dom_hue, dom_texture
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x) | .x == "", "Unknown", .x)))

cat_mm <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = cat_vars)  # one-hot

# Combine
umap_input <- cbind(num_vars_clean, cat_mm)
# Remove zero-variance columns (prevents NaN after scaling)
good_cols <- apply(umap_input, 2, function(x) is.finite(sd(x)) && sd(x) > 0)
umap_input2 <- umap_input[, good_cols, drop = FALSE]

umap_scaled <- scale(umap_input2)

# hard safety check
stopifnot(all(is.finite(umap_scaled)))

library(umap)
set.seed(42)

umap_out <- umap(
  umap_scaled,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean"
)

umap_coords <- as.data.frame(umap_out$layout)
names(umap_coords) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

umap_df <- bind_cols(
  pedon_umap %>%
    select(peiidref, upedonid, series,
           taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize,
           dom_texture, dom_hue),
  umap_coords
)


ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = taxsubgrp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP (taxonomy + morphology + texture)",
       color = "Subgroup")
ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = dom_texture)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP colored by dominant field texture", color = "Texture")

ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = taxorder)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP colored by Order", color = "Order")

#color by sand percentage:
umap_df <- bind_cols(
  pedon_umap %>%
    select(
      peiidref, upedonid, series,
      taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize,
      dom_texture, dom_hue,
      mean_sand   # <-- add this
    ),
  umap_coords
)

#plot by order:
ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = taxorder)) +
```
